Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.annotations

Annotation Interface OnPrime

@Documented @Retention(CLASS) @Target(METHOD) public @interface OnPrime
Marks a method of a function class that warms the function's own dependencies before a snapshot: with AWS Lambda SnapStart, Cloudhopper calls it before Lambda takes the snapshot, so that restored instances start with, e.g., SDK clients created, a price list loaded or the classes of a first database call initialized. Without SnapStart it is not called. 

 public class Prices {
     private final PriceList prices = new PriceList();

     @OnPrime
     void prime() {
         prices.load();
     }

     @Function(name = "price") ...
 }

The method has no parameters; it may throw exceptions, which are logged and do not stop the snapshot. All instances restored from one snapshot share what it creates: no random values, unique IDs or credentials that must differ per instance, and connections that may have been closed by the time of the restore must be reopened in the function call.
